svg.title: US119 — Complete a record owned by another replica (command forwarded to the owner)

g.text: US119 — Complete a record owned by another replica (command forwarded to the owner)
write model of replica 1: findById(id) → empty
completionDate >= startDate, not in the future;
(peer request: the owner does not touch the aircraft)
404 from a peer = "not mine" → next peer;
4xx from the owner → same status to the client;
IN_PROGRESS records of reg (records of EVERY replica)
[] (the completed one is excluded by id)
[another record ongoing, or Aircraft Management fails]
Only the owner writes a record, so there is a single version of it and its events come in order.
The same forwarding is used by US217 (PATCH /component → MaintenanceRecordCategorized).
